products.name: Azure Épure
products.desc: Our priority fragrance — fresh, elegant and the finest place to begin. Azure-clean air, cool iris and white musk: a cloudless sky, made wearable.

products.name: Ambre Velours
products.desc: The sweeter side of the House: golden amber, Bourbon vanilla and benzoin, wrapped in the warmth of velvet.

products.name: Oud Serein
products.desc: Serene oud: Laotian oud and cedar, deepened by sandalwood — woody, quiet and certain, without a trace of harshness.

reviews.author: Anna K.
reviews.content: Azure Épure is where I started — and a year later it is still the one I reach for. Fresh, elegant, quietly expensive.

reviews.author: James W.
reviews.content: Oud Serein is the calmest oud I have ever worn: woody depth, no harshness. It lasts from morning meetings to midnight.

reviews.author: Camille D.
reviews.content: Ambre Velours feels like velvet on a winter evening — sweet, but never childish. My signature for three months now.

reviews.author: Sophie M.
reviews.content: I began with the discovery set and finished with all three flacons. Azure Épure by day, Ambre Velours by night.
